sessions.name: A
sessions.reply:
The command that works, run from the project root (`<run>\work\L1\b\w`), is:

```
PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

Both tests pass (2 tests, OK).

Without `PYTHONPATH=src`, the run fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'ledgerlite'`. The package lives under `src/` and isn't installed, and the project has no `pyproject.toml` or `setup.py`. I didn't change any files.

That syntax is for Git Bash. In PowerShell it would be `$env:PYTHONPATH="src"; python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`.

sessions.name: B
sessions.reply:
I added `Ledger.close(name)` in `src/ledgerlite/__init__.py`. It raises `ValueError` if the account's balance is not zero. Otherwise it removes the account. Closing an account that doesn't exist raises `KeyError`, the same as `balance()` does.

I also added `test_close_requires_zero_balance` in `tests/test_ledger.py`. It checks that closing a funded account raises `ValueError` and leaves the account in place. After the balance is returned to zero, `close` succeeds.

The full suite passes: 3 tests, all OK. I ran it with `PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
